mechanism: Both drugs inhibit monoamine oxidase and aldehyde dehydrogenase, increasing risk of hypertensive crisis, psychosis, and severe CNS toxicity through additive effects on catecholamine metabolism.
action: Avoid concurrent use; if disulfiram is necessary for alcohol use disorder, discontinue isocarboxazid at least 2 weeks prior and ensure adequate washout period before initiating disulfiram.
